items.title: Morgan Stanley Ends Anthropic Stock Support After Just One Day
items.summary: Morgan Stanley closed Anthropic’s price support after one day as ANT stock slid toward its $83 IPO price. Will the stock hold?

items.title: 4 Wall Street Giants That Raised Their Dividends for Income Investors
items.summary: Four big banks keep lifting their payouts, yet each one hides a different threat to the next raise. One cut its dividend to a dime, and another sits on a capital cushion that is shrinking fast. Which check can retirees trust most?

items.title: Coinbase falls below Morgan Stanley’s $120 target
items.summary: The Coinbase stock took about two weeks to fall below the bank’s $120 target as crypto trading dries up.

items.title: Rare Citi signal seen just 3 times since 2000 is days from triggering
items.summary: Investing.com - Citi’s quantitative strategy team warns that its major bearish indicator is on course to trigger in the coming days, a signal that has fired only three times since 2000, each time preceding major drawdowns in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100.

items.title: SanDisk Tumbles 8% as TrendForce Turns Bearish on 2027 NAND Prices; Micron Falls 5%, SK Hynix Slides 4%
items.summary: SanDisk has already lost nearly half its value in a month, and a new price forecast just hit the one product it sells. Can its locked-in data center contracts protect the stock when NAND turns, or do the bears have this right?

items.title: No bear in sight: Major Wall St banks set 2027 S&P 500 targets
items.summary: Investing.com - A new survey of eight Wall Street strategists puts the average S&P 500 year-end 2027 target at 8,638, implying roughly a 20% advance from current levels and what would be a fifth consecutive annual gain — the longest winning streak since 2007. The bullish consensus arrives against a turbulent near-term backdrop with the S&P 500 trading at lowest levels since May this year.

items.title: SiTime (SITM) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Reassess AI Growth Upside
items.summary: SiTime’s modeled fair value has been reset from US$832.27 to US$713.75, which marks a sizeable change in how upside potential is being framed. Recent analyst commentary around AI timing demand, execution risks and prior share price moves helps explain why targets across the Street have moved in different directions, even as the core SiTime story still focuses on precision timing for high performance systems. items.title: Morgan Stanley (MS) Debuts Four Active UCITS ETFs In Europe
items.summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS) has launched an active ETF platform in Europe using four Ireland domiciled UCITS ETFs. The new range focuses on long term thematic and actively managed strategies aimed at investors outside the U.S. The ETFs are registered under Irish UCITS rules, giving passporting access to multiple European markets.
